en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with a large historic town hall building featuring a steep tiled roof, central gable with a clock, and a small tower with a cupola on top. Several people stand and walk in the open square, which is lined with young trees. Surrounding the square are smaller residential or commercial buildings, one with a sign visible on the left. The printed title text appears at the top of the card.
